newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers steady, heifers $1.00 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 500 slaughter steers and 700 heifers following the weekly movement of 89,000 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1100 lbs 68.00.
